entities.summary: Ruslan Khadzhismelovich Tsalikov is a Russian politician best known as a former First Deputy Minister of Defence and Full Cavalier of the Order "For Merit to the Fatherland". He has the federal state civilian service rank of 1st class Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation.
